title: Coffee Cream Pots
blurb: Light, creamy coffee-flavoured desserts that set into smooth individual portions with just a hint of sweetness.
steps: Dissolve the instant coffee in the boiling water in a small bowl, then sprinkle the gelatin powder over and stir until completely dissolved.
Warm the soy beverage in a small pan over low heat, then add the sugar and stir until dissolved.
Put the cream cheese in a mixing bowl and whisk until smooth, then gradually pour in the warm soy mixture, whisking constantly until fully combined.
Add the coffee and gelatin mixture to the cream cheese mixture and whisk until smooth and even.
Pour the mixture into six small glasses or ramekins and refrigerate for at least two hours until set.
Serve chilled directly from the fridge.
